$comment: Function-calling tool definitions for file-analyzer. Drop these into a `tools` array for Grok / DeepSeek / OpenAI-style APIs. They mirror the MCP server (src/mcp_server.py); dispatch each call to `python -m src.main ...` (use --quiet for pure-JSON stdout) or to the MCP tool of the same name. Intended loop: analyze_repository once, then query the returned `database` with SQL over the v_* views.

function.name: analyze_repository
function.description: Analyze a repository and build a queryable SQLite database of everything in it (files, per-language symbols and imports, DB schemas, data-file profiles, archives, binaries, configs, docs). Never executes the code. Returns a JSON summary including the `database` path to pass to query/list_views/describe_schema, plus counts and the installed v_* views.

path.description: Directory to analyze. Must be a git repository unless no_git is true.

no_git.description: Census every file on disk instead of only git-tracked files. Default: false.

workers.description: Worker count for the concurrent stages. Default: CPU count.

function.name: query
function.description: Run a single read-only SQL query against an analyzed repository database. Only one SELECT/WITH statement is accepted; the database is opened read-only. Prefer the ready-made v_* views (see list_views), e.g. 'SELECT * FROM v_import_edges'. Returns {row_count, truncated, rows}.

sql.description: A single SELECT or WITH query.

db_path.description: Path to repository.db from analyze_repository (its `database` field).

limit.description: Max rows to return (<= 0 = no cap). Default: 100.

function.name: list_views
function.description: List the v_* analysis views installed in a repository database. Each view is a ready-made answer readable with 'SELECT * FROM <view>' via query. Returns {count, views:[{name, base_tables}]}.

function.name: describe_schema
function.description: Describe the base tables (names, columns, types) of a repository database, plus optionally the installed views and their catalog SQL. Use to write precise SQL when the v_* views don't cover a question.

include_views.description: Also return the installed views and their SELECT SQL. Default: true.

function.name: run_component
function.description: Run a single analyzer building block over a repo and return its tables JSON, without the full pipeline. Component is a language analyzer ('PythonAnalyzer', 'RustAnalyzer', ...), a plane ('code','schema','data','config','text','markup','document','database','misc'), or 'census'. Call list_components for valid names.

out_dir.description: Where to write the emitted JSON. Default: <path>/.file-analyzer.

function.name: list_components
function.description: Enumerate the analyzer building blocks runnable via run_component (special components, planes, and per-language analyzer class names).
